summary: Episode #31 discusses FAAMG stocks, their valuations, growth rates, and market dominance. The hosts cover Amazon's high PE ratio and low margins, Facebook's strong profitability, Microsoft's Azure growth, Apple's hardware business, and Google/Alphabet's position. Other topics include Disney's streaming service launch, GDPR impacts on tech companies, WeWork's business model and valuation issues, Alibaba's potential fraud concerns, and chip shortages affecting AI and crypto mining. The episode emphasizes the importance of understanding valuations beyond simple PE ratios and analyzing business models in tech investments.
key_takeaways: FAAMG stocks represent over 14% of S&P 500
Amazon's AWS drives profitability with 60-70% margins
GDPR allows users to disable personalized ads which could impact Facebook and Google
Tech giants developing their own chips to reduce supplier dependency
Valuation metrics like PEG show Facebook (0.3) and Microsoft (0.8) may be reasonably valued despite high P/E
